acceptance_rule: Policy approval is not source completeness or dataset acceptance. Exact effective-dated official terms and applicable holder class are required.

policies.accounting: Authoritative entitlement cash; no Order/Fill; no adjusted-price double count.

Exact gross final-implementation cash for the ordinary exchange-tradable public A-share holder; unrestricted/public A term over restricted or special-holder terms; no averaging, tolerance, tax-net substitution or synthetic ex-price inference.
Official quantity ratio; aggregate basis preserved unless authoritative tax/basis terms require otherwise; cash unchanged.

Use an exact official whole-share allocation when individually evidenced; otherwise floor the theoretical post-event quantity, book no synthetic cash or tradable fraction, preserve aggregate basis on the remaining whole shares, and audit the discarded fractional bound.
NET_PASS_THROUGH_NO_BASIS_ALLOCATION; original quantity and basis unchanged; no synthetic value or loss.
NO_SUBSCRIPTION_NO_MONETIZATION_V1; no capital injection; preserve metadata.
Official ratio; authoritative fractional mechanism first, otherwise floor/no fabricated cash or shares; basis retained if whole quantity positive, otherwise zero-whole write-off.
Remove proportional basis with uncompensated original shares; loss is corporate-action PnL; approved fractional convention when official mechanics unavailable.
Remove nonexistent position and all orphan basis; corporate-action loss; no Order/Fill.
Basis transferred to successor; approved floor/no cash for unreproducible allocation; zero-whole basis write-off.
Official tax allocation, reference values or valuation ratios; never invent a multi-asset basis split.
Nonelective exact cash per share times eligible quantity; remove shares and basis; corporate-action PnL equals cash minus basis; trading PnL zero.
Apply exact official consideration and basis allocation; materially ambiguous multi-asset allocation follows human-stop rule.
No participation unless existing predeclared policy states otherwise; no hindsight election.
Preserve accounting continuity only; non-orderable, non-executable, excluded from factor ranking.
Official identity/terms, verified inability to trade through uncertainty, authoritative first tradable Bar required; apply before that Bar without inventing registry time.

Stop only when material to quantity/cash/basis/eligibility, unmappable to approved policy, official evidence nondeterministic, and alternatives materially change results; finish independent work first.
